# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 25 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 25:2 — walked in all the ways vs. followed in all the ways

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "walked in all the ways of his father Adam" | Literal ambulavit |
| LOGOS | "walked in all the ways of his father Adam" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "followed in all the ways of his father Adam" | Modern idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree: 'walked.' The biblical metaphor of 'walking in the ways' (ambulare in viis) should be preserved. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
